parameters.name: column_chunk_compress_min_depth
parameters.description: The youngest chunk generation whose spilled bodies are lz4-compressed in the buffer pool; younger generations store uncompressed. 0 compresses every spilled body.

parameters.name: column_paged_batcher_budget_fraction
parameters.description: Budget fraction for chunk spilling: the buffer pool multiplies it against physical RAM and the column pager's tiered policy against the announced memory limit. Total pool budget = max(ram * fraction, 128 MiB).

parameters.name: column_paged_batcher_eager_backing
parameters.description: Eagerly compress buffer-pool chunks to compressed-but-resident on idle spill threads, so budget-driven eviction is a pure page release. Only meaningful with spill workers.

parameters.name: column_paged_batcher_lz4
parameters.description: Compress column-paged batcher chunks with lz4 on the spill path. Only meaningful when `enable_column_paged_batcher_spill = true`.

parameters.name: column_paged_batcher_pool_rss_target_fraction
parameters.description: Ceiling on the buffer pool's total RSS as a fraction of physical RAM; the headroom above the slot budget holds compressed-but-resident extents. Zero pages extents out immediately.

parameters.name: column_paged_batcher_spill_worker_fraction
parameters.description: Buffer-pool spill threads for off-worker eviction I/O, as a fraction of the process's timely workers, rounded up; 0 evicts inline on the caller.

parameters.name: column_paged_batcher_swap_pageout
parameters.description: Eagerly evict the column-paged batcher's lz4-compressed swap-backend spill chunks from RSS via `MADV_PAGEOUT` (they otherwise receive no madvise and are reclaimed only lazily). Only meaningful when `column_paged_batcher_lz4 = true` and the swap backend is active.

parameters.name: compute_peek_response_stash_read_memory_budget_bytes

parameters.name: compute_peek_response_stash_threshold_bytes

parameters.description: Enable checking for crash/OOM-looping replicas during 0dt caught-up checks. Emergency break-glass flag to disable this feature if needed.

parameters.name: enable_0dt_caught_up_stability_check
parameters.description: Require clusters to stay caught-up and healthy for a stability period before being considered ready during 0dt deployments. Emergency break-glass flag: disabling reverts to treating a caught-up cluster as ready with no replica-health requirement, which differs from setting the stability period to zero (a zero period still requires all replicas to be healthy).

parameters.name: enable_0dt_hydrate_migrated_builtin_mvs

Emergency break-glass flag: disabling excludes migrated MVs (and their dependents) from the caught-up check again, so promotion proceeds with them unhydrated. Not an exact revert: a collection with no live leader frontier must be hydrated either way. Only takes effect when the leader is new enough for the write to make progress, and is read once at startup, so changing it means setting it on the leader and restarting the new deployment.

parameters.name: persist_state_update_lease_timeout

parameters.name: persist_state_versions_recent_live_diffs_limit

parameters.name: persist_stats_audit_panic
parameters.description: If set (as it is by default), panic on any auditing failure. If not, report an error but pass along the data as normal. This should almost certainly be paired with an audit rate of 100%, so all parts are audited, for consistency.

parameters.name: persist_stats_audit_percent
parameters.description: Percent of filtered data to opt in to correctness auditing (Materialize).

parameters.name: persist_stats_budget_bytes
parameters.description: The budget (in bytes) of how many stats to maintain per batch part.

parameters.name: persist_stats_collection_enabled

parameters.name: persist_stats_filter_enabled

parameters.name: persist_stats_untrimmable_columns_suffix

parameters.name: persist_use_critical_since_catalog
parameters.description: Use the critical since (instead of the overall since) for the Persist-backed catalog.

parameters.name: persist_use_critical_since_snapshot
parameters.description: Use the critical since (instead of the overall since) when taking snapshots in the controller or in fast-path peeks.

parameters.name: persist_use_critical_since_source
parameters.description: Use the critical since (instead of the overall since) in the Persist source.

parameters.name: persist_use_critical_since_txn
parameters.description: Use the critical since (instead of the overall since) when initializing a subscribe.

parameters.name: persist_validate_part_bounds_on_read

parameters.name: persist_validate_part_bounds_on_write
parameters.description: Validate the part lower <= the batch lower and the part upper <= batch upper,for the batch being appended.

parameters.name: persist_write_combine_inline_writes
parameters.description: If set, re-encode inline writes if they don't fit into the batch metadata limits.

parameters.name: pg_schema_validation_interval
parameters.description: Interval to re-validate the schemas of ingested tables.

parameters.name: pg_source_connect_timeout
parameters.description: Sets the timeout applied to socket-level connection attempts for PG replication connections (Materialize).

parameters.name: pg_source_replication_slot_creation_timeout
parameters.description: Timeout for creating a replication slot on the upstream PostgreSQL server. Applied as `lock_timeout`, which bounds the wait for in-progress upstream transactions to end. Has no effect with physical standbys.

parameters.name: pg_source_snapshot_collect_strict_count
parameters.description: Please see <https://dev.materialize.com/api/rust-private/mz_storage_types/parameters/struct.PgSourceSnapshotConfig.html#structfield.collect_strict_count>

parameters.name: pg_source_snapshot_statement_timeout
parameters.description: Sets the `statement_timeout` value to use during the snapshotting phase of PG sources (Materialize)

parameters.name: pg_source_tcp_configure_server
parameters.description: Sets whether to apply the TCP configuration parameters on the server when connecting to PG via `mz_postgres_util` (Materialize).

parameters.name: pg_source_tcp_keepalives_idle
parameters.description: Sets the amount of idle time before a keepalive packet is sent on the connection when connecting to PG via `mz_postgres_util` (Materialize).

parameters.name: pg_source_tcp_keepalives_interval
parameters.description: Sets the time interval between TCP keepalive probes when connecting to PG via replication (Materialize).

parameters.name: pg_source_tcp_keepalives_retries
parameters.description: Sets the maximum number of TCP keepalive probes that will be sent before dropping a connection when connecting to PG via `mz_postgres_util` (Materialize).

parameters.name: pg_source_tcp_user_timeout
parameters.description: Sets the TCP user timeout when connecting to PG via `mz_postgres_util` (Materialize).

parameters.name: pg_source_validate_timeline
parameters.description: Whether to treat a timeline switch as a definite error

parameters.name: pg_source_wal_sender_timeout
parameters.description: Sets the `wal_sender_timeout` value to use during the replication phase of PG sources (Materialize)

parameters.name: pg_timestamp_oracle_connection_pool_max_size
parameters.description: Maximum size of the Postgres/CRDB connection pool, used by the Postgres/CRDB timestamp oracle.

parameters.name: pg_timestamp_oracle_connection_pool_max_wait
parameters.description: The maximum time to wait when attempting to obtain a connection from the Postgres/CRDB connection pool, used by the Postgres/CRDB timestamp oracle.

parameters.name: pg_timestamp_oracle_connection_pool_ttl
parameters.description: The minimum TTL of a Consensus connection to Postgres/CRDB before it is proactively terminated

parameters.name: pg_timestamp_oracle_connection_pool_ttl_stagger
parameters.description: The minimum time between TTLing Consensus connections to Postgres/CRDB.

parameters.name: pg_timestamp_oracle_statement_timeout
parameters.description: The server-side statement timeout to set on Postgres/CRDB connections used by the Postgres/CRDB timestamp oracle. A value of zero leaves the statement timeout unset.

parameters.name: plan_insights_notice_fast_path_clusters_optimize_duration
parameters.description: Enable plan insights fast path clusters calculation if the optimize step took less than this duration.

parameters.name: postgres_fetch_slot_resume_lsn_interval
parameters.description: Interval to poll `confirmed_flush_lsn` to get a resumption lsn.

parameters.name: privatelink_status_update_quota_per_minute
parameters.description: Sets the per-minute quota for privatelink vpc status updates to be written to the storage-collection-backed system table. This value implies the total and burst quota per-minute.

parameters.name: read_then_write_max_dependencies
parameters.description: Maximum number of transitive dependencies validated for a read-then-write statement before it is rejected.

parameters.name: replica_hydration_history_retention_period
parameters.description: How long to retain rows in mz_internal.mz_replica_hydration_history.

parameters.name: replica_metrics_history_retention_interval
parameters.description: The interval of time to keep when truncating the replica metrics history.

parameters.name: replica_status_history_retention_window
parameters.description: On reboot, truncate up all entries past the retention window in the mz_cluster_replica_status_history collection (Materialize).

parameters.name: scram_iterations
parameters.description: Iterations to use when hashing passwords. Higher iterations are more secure, but take longer to validated. Please consider the security risks before reducing this below the default value.

parameters.name: sentry_filters
parameters.description: Sets additional default directives to apply to sentry logging. These apply on top of a default `info` directive. Directives other than `module=off` are likely incorrect.

parameters.name: sql_server_cdc_cleanup_change_table

parameters.name: sql_server_cdc_cleanup_change_table_max_deletes
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries that can be deleted by using a single statement.

parameters.name: sql_server_max_lsn_wait
parameters.description: Maximum amount of time we'll wait for SQL Server to report an LSN (in other words for CDC to be fully enabled)

parameters.name: sql_server_snapshot_progress_report_interval

parameters.name: sql_server_source_validate_restore_history

parameters.name: ssh_check_interval

parameters.name: ssh_keepalives_idle
parameters.description: Controls the keepalive idle interval for connections to SSH bastions via `mz_ssh_util`.

parameters.name: statement_logging_default_sample_rate

parameters.name: statement_logging_max_data_credit
parameters.description: The maximum number of bytes that can be logged for statement logging in short burts, or NULL if unlimited (Materialize).

parameters.name: statement_logging_max_sample_rate
parameters.description: The maximum rate at which statements may be logged. If this value is less than that of `statement_logging_sample_rate`, the latter is ignored (Materialize).

parameters.name: statement_logging_target_data_rate
parameters.description: The maximum sustained data rate of statement logging, in bytes per second, or NULL if unlimited (Materialize).

parameters.name: statement_logging_use_reproducible_rng
parameters.description: Whether statement logging with reproducible RNG is allowed (Materialize).

parameters.name: storage_cluster_shutdown_grace_period
parameters.description: When dataflows observe an invariant violation it is either due to a bug or due to the cluster being shut down. This configuration defines the amount of time to wait before panicking the process, which will register the invariant violation.

parameters.name: storage_dataflow_delay_sources_past_rehydration
parameters.description: Whether or not to delay sources producing values in some scenarios (namely, upsert) till after rehydration is finished

parameters.name: storage_dataflow_max_inflight_bytes
parameters.description: The maximum number of in-flight bytes emitted by persist_sources feeding storage dataflows. Defaults to backpressure enabled (Materialize).

parameters.name: storage_dataflow_max_inflight_bytes_disk_only
parameters.description: Whether or not `storage_dataflow_max_inflight_bytes` applies only to upsert dataflows using disks. Defaults to true (Materialize).

parameters.name: storage_dataflow_max_inflight_bytes_to_cluster_size_fraction
parameters.description: The fraction of the cluster replica size to be used as the maximum number of in-flight bytes emitted by persist_sources feeding storage dataflows. If not configured, the storage_dataflow_max_inflight_bytes value will be used.

parameters.name: storage_dataflow_suspendable_sources
parameters.description: Whether storage dataflows should suspend execution while downstream operators are still processing data.

parameters.name: storage_downgrade_since_during_finalization
parameters.description: When enabled, force-downgrade the controller's since handle on the shardduring shard finalization

parameters.name: storage_enforce_external_addresses
parameters.description: Whether or not to enforce that external connection addresses are global (not private or local) when resolving them

parameters.name: storage_persist_sink_description_lookahead
parameters.description: Determines how far past the remap upper the source persist sink will commit to a ceiling in order to group data into one batch and one description, and whether the Postgres replication stream is read while a snapshot runs. Zero disables both, leaving every timestamp writing its own batch. Other values below the tick interval are clamped to the tick interval.

parameters.name: storage_record_source_sink_namespaced_errors
parameters.description: Whether or not to record namespaced errors in the status history tables

parameters.name: storage_rocksdb_cleanup_tries
parameters.description: How many times to try to cleanup old RocksDB DB's on disk before giving up.

parameters.name: storage_rocksdb_use_merge_operator
parameters.description: Use the native rocksdb merge operator where possible.

parameters.name: storage_server_maintenance_interval
parameters.description: The interval at which the storage server performs maintenance tasks. Zero enables maintenance on every iteration.

parameters.name: storage_shrink_upsert_unused_buffers_by_ratio
parameters.description: Configuration ratio to shrink unusef buffers in upsert by

parameters.name: storage_sink_ensure_topic_config
parameters.description: If `skip`, don't check the config of existing topics; if `check`, fetch the config and warn if it does not match the expected configs; if `alter`, attempt to change the upstream to match the expected configs.

parameters.name: storage_sink_progress_search
parameters.description: If set, iteratively search the progress topic for a progress record with increasing lookback.

parameters.name: storage_source_decode_fuel
parameters.description: The maximum amount of work to do in the persist_source mfp_and_decode operator before yielding.

parameters.name: storage_statistics_collection_interval

parameters.name: storage_statistics_interval
parameters.description: The interval to submit statistics to `mz_source_statistics_per_worker` and `mz_sink_statistics` (Materialize).

parameters.name: storage_statistics_retention_duration
parameters.description: The time after which we delete per replica statistics (for sources and sinks) after there have been no updates.

parameters.name: storage_suspend_and_restart_delay

parameters.name: superuser_reserved_connections

parameters.name: timely_zero_copy_limit

parameters.name: txn_wal_apply_ensure_schema_match

parameters.name: unsafe_enable_unorchestrated_cluster_replicas
